_note: Key Terms head -> target for calculus, where the head's wording matches neither a definitions entry name nor a lesson section title. A value starting with / is a lesson URL; anything else is a definitions entry id. '<registry key>:<term>' overrides the plain term for one tool. Terms deliberately absent stay bold: they are page-local scaffolding for a specific tool (iterate, Newton step, initial guess, concavity gap, DNE, f prime as a function, accumulator function, sample point, convergence order, closed-form derivative) and a definition would add nothing.
